our_interpretation: The relevant commentary is public discussion of the o3 announcement from December 20, 2024 through publication of this post on December 21.
Most means more than half of distinct commentary items, rather than more than half of their audience or impressions.
The plain reading of ignored is omitted or failed to take account of a distinction. It does not establish what a commentator privately understood.
Addressing both distinctions requires acknowledging that benchmark success does not establish AGI and that performance may vary across domains.
criteria.support_condition: A representative sample of contemporaneous commentary shows that more than half omitted or disregarded at least one distinction.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A representative sample shows that at least half addressed both distinctions.

evidence.explanation: Chollet explicitly addressed benchmark insufficiency; the article also discusses possible failures outside the tested distribution. This is a counterexample to universal omission, but Marcus claimed a majority, not unanimity.
